resources.string: A little friend, running on your phone.
Android AI preview · 0.1.0\nChat and picture analysis only. The full NoteBuddy game is not included yet.
Gemma 4 E2B · 2.59 GB\nDownload once, then run on this phone. Wi-Fi recommended. No API key or AI subscription.
Download the 2.59 GB model? Keep this app open. Your carrier may charge for mobile data. A paused download can resume.
Remove only the downloaded model? Your picture, companion and conversation will stay.
Paused. You can resume or try again.
Draw or choose a picture, then analyze it. AI selects colors, body parts and personality; the app draws a simple illustration. This is not full AI image generation.
Your picture and chat stay in this app on this device. Nothing is uploaded for AI processing. The model download connects to Hugging Face. AI responses can be inaccurate.
